glosses: to dine; to have dinner; to have supper

examples.text:
— Отстаньте, пожалуйста! Вон ужин готов! Садитесь ужинать!
Следователь и Дюковский сели ужинать.
examples.translation:
"Do leave off, please! There's supper ready. Sit down to supper!"
Tchubikov and Dyukovsky sat down to supper.
examples.english:
"Do leave off, please! There's supper ready. Sit down to supper!"
Tchubikov and Dyukovsky sat down to supper.

glosses: to cut (grain, etc.) at the root using a scythe or reaper
To eat; to eat dinner or supper.
To give a dinner to; to furnish with the chief meal; to feed.

examples.text: Brown accompanied his jolly landlord and the rest of his friends into the large and smoky kitchen, where this savoury mess reeked on an oaken table, massy enough to have dined Johnnie Armstrong and his merry-men.
I dined them, treated them, listened to the truth of their hearts, stole their names and through this means bluffed and bartered my way into courthouse, palace and colonial manor.

glosses: To dine upon; to have to eat.
das Abendessen zu sich nehmen, Abendbrot essen

examples.text: Habt ihr schon zu Abend gegessen?
Wann esst ihr gewöhnlich zu Abend?
Слушайте, мы проголодались. Нам всем уже пора ужинать.
examples.translation: Poslyšte, vyhládlo nám. Všichni už bychom se měli navečeřet.
